# Temporal Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](gmeow-TemporalFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TemporalFrame>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reference system for expressing time — the temporal counterpart of [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md). Decomposed into a [`TimeScale`](gmeow-TimeScale.md), an optional [`CalendarSystem`](gmeow-CalendarSystem.md), and an optional [`ReferencePosition`](gmeow-ReferencePosition.md). Every crisp instant or interval is asserted relative to a [`TemporalFrame`](gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the time-reckoning system a dateTime is expressed in — the scale/calendar/position bundle every crisp instant or interval points at to satisfy the frame-relativity gate (P11).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a bespoke frame when a seeded one ([`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md), [`gmeow:temporalFrameTAI`](../individuals/gmeow-temporalFrameTAI.md), the per-calendar civil frames) already fits, and avoid using it as the timestamp value itself — the frame interprets the value, it is not the value.

### How to use

- Decompose it into exactly one [`gmeow:frameTimeScale`](../properties/gmeow-frameTimeScale.md) plus optional [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](../properties/gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md) and [`gmeow:frameReferencePosition`](../properties/gmeow-frameReferencePosition.md); reference it from instants via [`gmeow:inTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-inTemporalFrame.md) and from intervals via [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md).

### Examples

- ex:myFrame a [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](gmeow-TemporalFrame.md); [`gmeow:frameTimeScale`](../properties/gmeow-frameTimeScale.md) [`gmeow:timeScaleUTC`](../individuals/gmeow-timeScaleUTC.md); [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](../properties/gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md) [`gmeow:calendarGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-calendarGregorian.md).
